name: aeos-seo-mcp

tools.name: gsc_list_sites
tools.description: List all Search Console properties accessible by the authorized account.

tools.name: gsc_search_analytics
tools.description: Run a Search Analytics query against a Search Console property. Returns clicks, impressions, ctr and position grouped by the chosen dimensions.

tools.name: gsc_url_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a URL via the Search Console URL Inspection API.

inspectionUrl.description: Full URL to inspect (must belong to the property).

tools.name: gsc_list_sitemaps
tools.description: List sitemaps registered for a Search Console property.

tools.name: gsc_get_sitemap
tools.description: Fetch metadata and error counts for a specific sitemap.

tools.name: ga4_run_report
tools.description: Run a GA4 report (properties.runReport). Returns dimension/metric rows for the specified date ranges.

tools.name: ga4_run_realtime
tools.description: Run a GA4 realtime report (properties.runRealtimeReport).

tools.name: ga4_batch_run_reports
tools.description: Run up to 5 GA4 reports in one call (properties.batchRunReports).

tools.name: ga4_list_metadata
tools.description: List dimensions and metrics available for a GA4 property.

tools.name: seo_find_keyword_opportunities
tools.description: Identify queries with high impressions but underperforming CTR/position (positions 5–25). Returns ranked list with projected click lift if rankings improve.

ctrCurve.description: Custom CTR curve { "1": 0.3, "2": 0.15, ... }. Overrides industry default.

tools.name: seo_content_decay_report
tools.description: Compare last N days vs the previous N days by page; flag pages whose clicks dropped beyond the threshold. Supports YoY comparison and statistical methods (zscore/ewma over daily series).

tools.name: seo_striking_distance
tools.description: Find queries on page 2 (or just below the fold) — high-impression queries in positions 8–20 that are realistic to push into the top 3. Returns projected click lift and effort estimate.

tools.name: seo_keyword_cannibalization
tools.description: Detect queries where multiple pages compete (no clear winner). Returns severity-ranked list with competing pages and a recommendation (merge, canonicalize, de-optimize).

tools.name: seo_ranking_changes
tools.description: Diff query rankings between two GSC date ranges. Saves a snapshot of the current period for future comparisons. Supports YoY comparison.

tools.name: seo_ctr_anomalies
tools.description: Find queries/pages whose CTR is significantly below the curve expected for their position — high-leverage candidates for title/meta rewrites.

ctrCurve.description: Custom CTR curve { "1": 0.3, ... }. Overrides industry default.

tools.name: seo_branded_vs_nonbranded
tools.description: Split GSC traffic into branded vs non-branded based on a list of brand terms.

tools.name: seo_landing_page_performance
tools.description: Cross GSC organic data (clicks, impressions, position) with GA4 engagement and conversions for the same set of landing pages.

tools.name: seo_query_intent_clusters
tools.description: Group top GSC queries by intent (informational / navigational / transactional / commercial) using token heuristics.

tools.name: seo_technical_health
tools.description: Inspect the top N pages via the URL Inspection API and list sitemap errors. Quick technical-SEO smoke test.

tools.name: seo_search_appearance_breakdown
tools.description: Break down GSC impressions/clicks by searchAppearance feature (rich result, AMP, video, web stories etc.) and detect WoW shifts. Useful to spot AI Overview / SERP feature impact.

tools.name: seo_diff_analyses
tools.description: Compute the delta between two prior SEO analysis JSON snapshots (output of seo-performance-analyst). Returns KPI deltas, new/resolved decay pages, new/resolved opportunities, and CTR anomaly transitions.

current.description: Current analysis JSON (with kpis, decay, oportunidades, ctr_anomalies fields).

tools.name: seo_index_coverage_audit
tools.description: Download a sitemap, sample URLs, and run URL Inspection in batch to compute index coverage stats. Returns % indexed, breakdown by coverageState, and list of problematic URLs. Respects GSC quota with throttling.

sitemapUrl.description: Full URL to the XML sitemap or sitemap index.

tools.name: seo_attribution_comparison
tools.description: Compare GA4 session-based (last-click proxy via sessionDefaultChannelGroup) vs first-touch attribution (firstUserDefaultChannelGrouping) for a given channel. Note: GA4 Standard does not expose full attribution model toggle — this is a proxy comparison using available dimensions.

channel.description: Channel group to compare, e.g. "Organic Search", "Paid Search".

tools.name: seo_derive_ctr_curve
tools.description: Derive a site-specific CTR curve from real GSC data. Returns average CTR per integer position (1–20) for queries meeting minImpressions. Use the output as ctrCurve param in seo_find_keyword_opportunities and seo_ctr_anomalies.

tools.name: seo_realtime_spike_detection
tools.description: Detect pages with anomalous realtime traffic (last 30 min) compared to the hourly baseline from the past N days. Returns pages in spike, magnitude (x times baseline), and probable source.

minActiveUsers.description: Minimum realtime active users to consider a page.

zThreshold.description: Z-score threshold to flag a spike.

tools.name: seo_audience_overlap
tools.description: Cross GA4 audience membership with organic search traffic to see which audiences drive (or are missing from) organic sessions. Requires audiences pre-configured in GA4. Returns sessions and conversions per audience, organic-filtered.

audienceIds.description: GA4 audience IDs (numeric strings). Found in GA4 Admin → Audiences.

tools.name: seo_international_split
tools.description: Break down GSC traffic by country and cross-check against sitemap URLs to identify countries where the site ranks but has no locale-specific page. Helps detect hreflang/international coverage gaps.

sitemapUrl.description: Sitemap URL to check for locale prefixes. If omitted, skips locale gap detection.

expectedLocales.description: Locale prefixes to look for in URLs, e.g. ["en", "pt-br", "es"]. Derived from sitemap if omitted.

tools.name: seo_render_report
tools.description: Render a SEO report as portuguese-BR markdown ready for client delivery. Templates: monthly_audit, opportunities, decay, ranking_changes, custom.

tools.name: crux_query
tools.description: Query the Chrome UX Report (CrUX) API for Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS, FCP, TTFB) for a given origin or URL. Requires SEO_MCP_CRUX_API_KEY env var.

formFactor.description: Device type filter. Omit for all.

tools.name: gsc_submit_sitemap
tools.description: Submit (register) a sitemap with Google Search Console. If already registered, this refreshes it. Requires confirm: true.

feedpath.description: Full URL of the sitemap (e.g., https://example.com/sitemap.xml).

confirm.description: Must be true to execute the write action.

tools.name: gsc_delete_sitemap
tools.description: Remove a sitemap registration from Search Console. Does not delete the actual file. Requires confirm: true.

feedpath.description: Full URL of the sitemap to remove.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute the write action.

tools.name: gsc_add_site
tools.description: Add a site (property) to Google Search Console for the authenticated account. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute the write action.

tools.name: gsc_remove_site
tools.description: Remove a site (property) from Search Console. DESTRUCTIVE: the property and all its data will no longer be accessible. Requires confirm: true AND confirmDeletion: "YES_DELETE_PROPERTY".

tools.name: indexing_publish_url
tools.description: Notify Google that a URL has been updated or removed via the Indexing API. Supports URL_UPDATED (request crawl/re-index) and URL_DELETED (notify removal). Requires confirm: true. Quota: 200/day.

tools.name: indexing_batch_publish
tools.description: Batch-notify Google about multiple URLs (up to 100). Throttled at 200ms between requests. Quota: 200/day total. Requires confirm: true.

tools.name: indexing_get_notification_status
tools.description: Get the latest notification metadata for a URL (when it was last notified via the Indexing API). Read-only.

tools.name: seo_submit_unindexed_urls
tools.description: Workflow: runs index coverage audit on a sitemap, identifies URLs not indexed (DISCOVERED_CURRENTLY_NOT_INDEXED or CRAWLED_CURRENTLY_NOT_INDEXED), and submits them via the Indexing API. Requires confirm: true.

sitemapUrl.description: Full URL of the sitemap to audit.

maxSubmissions.description: Max URLs to submit for indexing.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute submissions.

tools.name: seo_resubmit_sitemaps
tools.description: List all sitemaps for a property, identify those with errors or stale (not downloaded recently), and resubmit them. Requires confirm: true.

staleThresholdDays.description: Days since last download to consider stale.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute resubmissions.

tools.name: seo_title_meta_suggestions
tools.description: Generate title/meta-description rewrite recommendations for pages with CTR anomalies. Combines query and page CTR data to produce actionable suggestions with ROI scoring. Read-only composition (no write API calls).

tools.name: seo_content_brief
tools.description: Generate content briefs from keyword opportunity and striking distance data. Clusters related queries by token overlap and intent, producing actionable briefs for content creation or expansion. Read-only composition.

targetQuery.description: Focus on queries containing this term.

tools.name: seo_internal_linking_opportunities
tools.description: Identify internal linking opportunities by cross-referencing cannibalization data and striking distance queries. Finds source pages that could pass link equity to target pages. Read-only composition.

tools.name: seo_onpage_audit
tools.description: Audita uma URL: title, meta description, headings, canonical, hreflang, robots, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, imagens sem alt, structured data, contagem de palavras e keyword focus. Retorna score 0-100 + issues priorizados por severidade (critical/high/medium/low/info).

focusKeyword.description: Keyword-alvo. Ativa checagens de presença em title e conteúdo.

followRedirects.description: Seguir redirects antes de auditar (default: true).

tools.name: seo_pagespeed_insights
tools.description: Roda Lighthouse via PageSpeed Insights API (grátis) para uma URL. Retorna scores (Performance/SEO/A11y/Best Practices), Core Web Vitals (LCP/FCP/CLS/TBT/SI/TTI/TTFB/INP), LCP element, layout shifts, top 5 oportunidades por economia (ms) e diagnostics. Aceita mobile, desktop ou ambos. Opcional: SEO_MCP_PSI_API_KEY para quota maior.

tools.name: seo_structured_data_audit
tools.description: Extrai e valida structured data (JSON-LD, Microdata, RDFa) de uma URL. Reporta tipos schema.org encontrados, elegibilidade para Rich Results (Article, Product, FAQ, HowTo, Recipe, Event, Organization, LocalBusiness, VideoObject, JobPosting, Review, Course, BreadcrumbList, WebSite), props obrigatórios ausentes (high) e recomendados ausentes (low).

tools.name: seo_robots_audit
tools.description: Baixa e audita /robots.txt de um site. Reporta grupos User-agent, regras Allow/Disallow, Sitemap declarados, hosts. Flag: Disallow: / total, bloqueio de assets críticos (JS/CSS), crawl-delay alto, sitemap ausente. Opcional: testa paths específicos para saber se são bloqueados para um user-agent.

siteUrl.description: URL do site (qualquer path — origin será extraído).

testPaths.description: Lista de paths ou URLs para testar (ex.: /admin, https://x.com/blog).

tools.name: seo_sitemap_deep_validator
tools.description: Validação profunda de um sitemap (urlset ou sitemapindex): estrutura, tamanho, contagem de URLs vs limite 50k, validade de <lastmod> (ISO), <priority> (0-1), <changefreq>, <loc> ausente. Opcional: amostra N URLs e checa via HEAD status (200/3xx/404) para detectar sitemaps com URLs mortas ou de-canonicalizadas.

sampleUrls.description: N URLs para verificar via HEAD (default 0 = pula).

maxChildren.description: Máx. child sitemaps a processar quando root é sitemapindex (default 5).

tools.name: seo_hreflang_validator
tools.description: Valida tags hreflang de uma URL: extrai do HTML e do header HTTP Link, valida códigos ISO, self-reference, x-default, duplicatas, conflito com canonical. Opcional (default true): busca cada URL alternativa e verifica reciprocidade (a mais importante causa de hreflang que "não funciona").

checkReciprocity.description: Buscar cada URL alternativa e verificar link recíproco (default: true).

tools.name: seo_redirect_chain
tools.description: Segue os redirects de uma URL até o destino final. Reporta cadeia (3xx codes + Location + latência por hop), loops, chain length, upgrade HTTPS, cross-host e uso indevido de 302.

maxHops.description: Máximo de hops antes de parar (default: 10).

tools.name: seo_canonical_consistency
tools.description: Auditoria de canonical: cruza (1) canonical declarada no HTML, (2) URL efetiva pós-redirects, (3) userCanonical e googleCanonical reportados pelo GSC URL Inspection. Flag: canonical ausente, mismatch, protocolo diferente, Google escolheu canonical diferente do declarado, coverageState indicando duplicação.

siteUrl.description: Property GSC para cross-check via URL Inspection (default: SEO_MCP_DEFAULT_PROPERTY_GSC).

tools.name: seo_content_quality
tools.description: Métricas de qualidade de conteúdo para 1 URL: Flesch Reading Ease (pt/en), word count, sentenças, comprimento médio, densidade de keyword focus, presença no title/H1/primeiras 100 palavras, headings-to-word ratio, links por 100 palavras, imagens por 500 palavras. Retorna também top 20 unigramas e top 15 bigrams (com stopwords removidas) para análise semântica leve.

lang.description: Força idioma; senão infere de <html lang>.

tools.name: seo_alerts_config
tools.description: Configura alertas persistentes (SQLite). Ação = 'upsert' | 'list' | 'delete'. Kinds suportados: ranking_drop, clicks_drop, ctr_drop, position_worsening, index_coverage_drop, new_404_spike, cwv_regression. Params típicos: { thresholdAbs, thresholdPct, snapshotKind }. Alertas rodam contra snapshots existentes via seo_alerts_check.

name.description: Nome único do alerta (obrigatório em upsert/delete).

tools.name: seo_alerts_check
tools.description: Roda todos os alertas configurados para uma property contra o snapshot corrente vs. baseline (snapshot mais recente antes de referenceDate). Retorna lista de alertas disparados com severity (medium/high) e evidência (baseline vs. current vs. delta).

snapshotKind.description: Kind default a comparar se o config não especificar.

currentPayload.description: Payload atual a comparar. Se omitido, usa o snapshot de referenceDate.

tools.name: aeo_content_chunk_analysis
tools.description: Avalia se uma URL está estruturada para ingestão por LLMs / AI Overview / Perplexity: detecta H2/H3 formulados como perguntas + resposta imediata (Q&A pairs), resposta direta nos primeiros 300 chars, TL;DR/Resumo, listicles (ul/ol com 3+ itens), tabelas, passos numerados, definição no intro, estrutura de headings, tamanho médio de parágrafo. Retorna AEO score 0-100 + recomendações.

tools.name: aeo_faq_extractor
tools.description: Detecta pares Q&A no conteúdo (H2/H3 formulados como pergunta + próximos parágrafos como resposta) e gera JSON-LD FAQPage pronto para colar no <head>. Útil para elegibilidade em Rich Results FAQ e para dar chunks Q&A ao AI Overview.

tools.name: aeo_llms_txt_generator
tools.description: Gera /llms.txt (spec de índice curado para LLMs) a partir de: (a) lista explícita de URLs, (b) sitemap URL, ou (c) siteUrl (tenta /sitemap.xml). Busca title + meta description de cada URL, agrupa em seções (Home, Docs, Blog, Products, About, Pricing, Support, ou path inferido) e monta markdown com header + descrição + bullets. Retorna o conteúdo do llms.txt pronto para salvar na raiz.

siteUrl.description: URL raiz do site (usado para inferir sitemap e descrever o site).

urls.description: Lista explícita de URLs a incluir.

tools.name: aeo_entity_presence
tools.description: Verifica se uma entidade (marca, produto, pessoa, tópico) existe no Wikidata (Knowledge Graph público) e Wikipedia em N idiomas. Retorna QID, label, descrições, sitelinks, número de idiomas, e — se siteUrl for fornecido — cruza com propriedade P856 (official website) do Wikidata para detectar mismatch. Base para AEO/GEO: LLMs usam Wikidata + Wikipedia intensamente.

siteUrl.description: URL do seu site — para checar match com official website (P856).

tools.name: aeo_ai_overview_readiness
tools.description: Score composto (0-100) de prontidão para AI Overview / Perplexity / SGE, combinando: (40%) qualidade de chunks Q&A, (20%) structured data válido e elegível, (15%) FAQPage schema, (10%) estrutura de headings, (10%) resposta direta nos primeiros 300 chars, (5%) freshness (article:modified_time). Retorna breakdown + gaps priorizados.

tools.name: aeo_citation_watchlist
tools.description: Registro e análise manual de citações da sua marca em engines de resposta (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Bing Chat, Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Kagi, You). Fluxo: o usuário roda a consulta manualmente no LLM, cola aqui (com action='record') e este tool armazena para análise histórica. Actions: record, list, summarize, delete. Engines: perplexity, chatgpt_search, bing_chat, copilot, gemini, claude, kagi, you, other. Ideal para tracking longitudinal de share of voice em Answer Engines.

brand.description: Nome da marca ou termo monitorado.

cited.description: true se sua marca/URL foi citada (record).

position.description: Posição da citação na resposta, se aplicável.

answerExcerpt.description: Trecho da resposta do LLM (para contexto).

tools.name: seo_action_prioritizer
tools.description: Ingere findings de múltiplas tools (onpage_audit, structured_data, pagespeed, opportunities, decay, cannibalization, AEO, etc.) e produz ranking priorizado por ICE (Impact × Confidence / Effort) ou RICE (adiciona Reach). Normaliza severity → impact, code → category → effort, source → confidence. Retorna top N ações com score, rank e curva cumulativa (identifica onde está 80% do valor).

source.description: Nome da tool que produziu (ex.: seo_onpage_audit).

action.description: Ação sugerida. Se ausente, usa message/title/code.

category.description: Categoria pra estimar effort. Se ausente, é inferida do code.

findings.description: Array de findings de qualquer tool. Pode misturar sources.

tools.name: seo_wayback_diff
tools.description: Compara a versão atual de uma URL com um snapshot histórico da Internet Archive (Wayback Machine, grátis). Extrai title, meta description, H1, word count, headings count, canonical, schema types, hreflang count, links internos/externos, imagens — de ambas as versões — e produz diff estruturado + insights (title/H1/canonical mudou, conteúdo encolheu >30%, schema removido, links internos caíram). Útil para investigar content decay estrutural e regressões acidentais.

targetDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD do snapshot desejado. Se omitido, usa monthsAgo.

tools.name: seo_competitive_gap
tools.description: Compara sua URL com 1-5 URLs concorrentes (fornecidas pelo usuário) buscando cada uma via HTTP. Extrai title, headings, word count, structured data types, AEO score, top keywords e bigrams. Retorna diferença em word count, headings, AEO score, schemas ausentes, keywords que múltiplos concorrentes usam e você não, sub-tópicos (bigrams) descobertos. Zero custo: apenas fetch + parsing local.

tools.name: seo_llm_recommendation_synth
tools.description: Consolida N saídas de tools do MCP (onpage, pagespeed, structured, aeo, opportunities, decay, etc.) em (a) relatório markdown com contexto + top ações priorizadas por ICE + findings agrupados por fonte, e (b) um "synthesisPrompt" pronto para o cliente LLM (Claude/GPT/Gemini) produzir plano de ação executivo em pt-BR (diagnóstico + top 5 ações imediatas + médio prazo + métricas + riscos). Zero API externa — a síntese final é feita pelo LLM do cliente MCP.

goal.description: Objetivo do usuário em pt-BR (ex.: "Aumentar tráfego orgânico do blog em 30% em 90 dias").
